sources.entry: Rockxy - Open-source native macOS debugging proxy for inspecting HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, and GraphQL traffic.

summary.one_liner: Rockxy is an open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later) native macOS debugging proxy for intercepting, inspecting, and modifying HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, and GraphQL traffic.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Swift/SwiftUI/AppKit app built on SwiftNIO that captures traffic from Mac apps, CLI tools, and iOS devices or Simulator via a local proxy with guided setup. It offers per-host HTTPS decryption, bypass and block lists, Map Local and Map Remote rewriting, breakpoints, header modification, network throttling profiles, and JavaScript hooks on requests and responses. Users can filter and search captured traffic, edit and replay requests (Compose), diff two transactions, and save or export sessions as .rockxysession or HAR with secret redaction. The README also lists an AI Assistant for analyzing selected requests, a built-in local MCP server with read-only tools for external AI clients, and protocol labels for AI model API, JSON-RPC/Web3, and x402 payment-required traffic. It states that the public repository is the Community source edition and that official signed downloads may be licensed differently.
use_cases: Debug HTTPS API traffic from a Mac app or iOS device
Inspect WebSocket and GraphQL requests and responses
Mock or redirect API responses during development
Simulate slow networks or blocked hosts to test app behavior
Share redacted captured sessions or HAR files with teammates
Give an AI client read-only access to captured traffic via MCP
how_to_run: Build and run in Xcode; the Welcome window guides root CA setup, helper installation, and proxy activation.
notable: Native macOS app with no Electron shell, built with SwiftUI, AppKit, and SwiftNIO
Sandboxed JavaScriptCore hooks with a 5-second timeout and no filesystem or network access
Local MCP server with ten read-only tools, token authentication, and redaction on by default
Per-host HTTPS decryption with a root CA generated on first launch and stored in the Keychain
Compare view for side-by-side diffs of requests, headers, JSON, and bodies
caveats: Requires macOS 14.0+, Xcode 16+, and Swift 5.9 to build from source
The public Community edition is not the same artifact as the official signed DMG; some Pro capabilities are in the downstream distribution
Several features are listed as Coming Soon or future work (team sharing, redacted evidence bundles, deeper protocol-aware rules)
summary.license: AGPL-3.0-or-later (Community source edition; official signed downloads may fall under the Rockxy Binary EULA v1.0)
